scope: One-pass Photon address-node provider trial; no production API or full-stack capacity acceptance

providerTrial.trialScope: One-pass Photon /api provider-address-node comparison over 22 frozen API address cases. Descriptive trial only; not API p95, API H4, or M4 acceptance evidence.

photon.languageHandling: Saved language passed as lang. Returned language is reported only when an explicit response property exposes it; no script-based language inference.
photon.nearHandling: Photon has no near parameter; saved near coordinates are passed as its documented lat/lon location bias. No bias is added where the frozen case has no near.

correctedStopScoring.scope: Two frozen GTFS exact-stop cases only; candidates replayed from saved responses.

metricsScope.geometryExpectations: Frozen baseline coordinates, original tolerances and per-case scoring radius.

exactSourceOsmObject.notComparableReason: Frozen OpenTransit API responses expose place references rather than raw Photon OSM object IDs.

photon.scoringNote: Geometry-only scores use the frozen original expected coordinate, corpus radius, and tolerance. OSM identity is an additional exact-object score where the source case supplies a node ID; no address precision is inferred.

interpretation.peakNotes: Cgroup high-water values include startup through the trial. Separate component maxima are not a simultaneous aggregate peak. MOTIS/API components were idle during provider-only queries; no representative full-stack workload.
interpretation.excluded: Separate original M1 and unrelated desktop containers; no overall host-capacity claim
interpretation.remaining: Original address quality worsens 5/15 to 3/15, while 7 explicit source-node cases pass (5 near-assisted). Diagnose source languages/hierarchy and indexing; preserve address requirement and all acceptance gates.
